# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, well-supported foundation
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend to avoid prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# - Allow running as the root user, which is common in containers.
# - Force the use of TCP for inter-process communication, as InfiniBand/RDMA is not typically available.
# - Specify the primary network interface, usually 'eth0' in Docker/Kubernetes.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0

# Install build dependencies, clone, compile the application, and clean up in a single layer
# This approach minimizes the final image size.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    gfortran \
    git \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && \
    # Clone the latest version of the AMG (amg2023) source code
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git /opt/amg2023 && \
    # FIX: Change to the project's root directory before building.
    # The top-level Makefile correctly builds prerequisite libraries before the final executable.
    cd /opt/amg2023 && \
    # Compile the entire application suite
    make && \
    # Clean up to reduce image size
    # Remove the git repository history
    rm -rf /opt/amg2023/.git && \
    # Clean apt caches
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Add the application directory to the system's PATH environment variable.
# The 'amg' executable is located in the 'test' subdirectory after compilation.
ENV PATH="/opt/amg2023/test:${PATH}"

# Set a default working directory
WORKDIR /root

# Define the default command to be executed when the container starts
# This provides a shell for interactive use or can be overridden.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

Maximize the amg2023 figure of merit. Choose -n -P

for node resources. You MUST run on only one node. The size of the MiniCluster MUST be 1. To decide on the parameters you MUST multiply out 3 -P coordinates by 3 -n parameters and multiple by 64 bits to get a global problem size.
